narrative: The plot by the parlour door at the morning rehearsal. The Shrew at two. Your name is not among the entrances. You are not writing yourself in. A short note in the margin, not a part. You are going home when the morning is done. You will not come back at two to be useful.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the plot and went home.

entities.name: The Taming of the Shrew
